queries.query: Verify whether the OO query composition decision and deferred MCP boundary decision should be promoted into project memory. The current quality fixture still flags these topics as missing ingest output.
Validate the prompt-size fix by rerunning the failed auto-maintenance ingest and clear the accumulated failed jobs. The repo still has failed auto-maintenance work pending after the prompt-size fix.
Clarify ingest status language for stalled jobs The current wording can read like an active background drain even when no worker is running.

Step 3 next item is candidate intake boundary Roadmap Step 3 now puts the V2 runtime durable-memory candidate inbox and Project Memory intake boundary as the next active implementation task; candidate routing remains an open follow-up.
Read requests stay read-only When the user explicitly asks to read or review repo docs, treat that as a read-only request and stop after summarizing unless the user explicitly asks for changes.

Plan set verification completed The final plan set self-review passed `git diff --check` and a placeholder scan, and the external re-audit returned `Ready for Development`; no implementation tests were run in the planning phase.

Project Memory markdown-apply finalized The Project Memory markdown-apply design is finalized and externally audited; the spec, agenda, pseudocode, ADRs, and plan set are written under `docs/design/2026-06-23-project-memory-markdown-apply`.

Project command routing now uses learn and top-level ingest `project learn` routes through `ProjectService.runProjectLearn`, `project ingest` is removed from the command surface, `Makefile` calls top-level `myelin ingest`, and the inbox auto-update launcher also uses top-level `ingest <key>`.

Step 3 execution completed The ADL step 3 execution finished successfully: run 008 had already passed the full suite, and run 009 completed the follow-up cleanup so `project ingest` is no longer advertised in active docs. `bun run typecheck` and `git diff --check` passed.

Source consumption and bounded changesets Successful applies should write terminal source-consumption records into project-level state plus the run artifact, keep candidate and handoff lifecycle reconciliation separate, and store bounded before/after snippets plus hashes and provenance in `project-memory-changeset.json`.

Structured apply payloads Project Memory apply should use structured page and entry payloads rendered deterministically by code; the curator proposes content, but code owns canonical markdown rendering.

Staged apply recovery Project Memory apply should stage all writes, keep `project-memory.json` last, and preflight incomplete apply journals before new curator work so interrupted runs are replayed from saved artifacts instead of rerunning the curator.
Creation minimum for curated state Creation mode should mark `project-memory.json` curated only after an index plus at least one meaningful page, or an explicit rationale for no additional page.
